title: chore: unify all package versions to 1.0.0 with fixed changeset versioning
body:
All packages had inconsistent versions (0.1.0, 0.5.0, 0.5.1, 0.6.1). Unifies to 1.0.0 and locks them together for future releases.

- **`.changeset/config.json`** — Added all 36 publishable packages to `fixed` group so every future changeset bumps all packages to the same version
- **42 `package.json` files** — Set `version` to `1.0.0` across all packages, apps, and examples
- **`.changeset/release-v1.md`** — Changeset declaring `major` bump for all packages

```jsonc
// .changeset/config.json
{
  "fixed": [
    ["@object-ui/types", "@object-ui/core", "@object-ui/react", /* ...all 36 packages */]
  ]
}
```
